## Example 3.12 · What does class width change? {#l3-example-3-12-grouping .compact}

```{=html}
<div data-module="chart" data-set="haemoglobin" data-modes="frequency,cumulative" data-group="true" data-interval-notation="lower"></div>
```


c) Regroup using a class width of 2 and redraw the display.
d) Identify the modal class and the class containing the median in each display.
e) Explain how changing the class width changes what can be seen.
<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 48 · Example 3.12 · Complete the working in your booklet.</p>

::: notes
Width 1: modal and median class $13\text{–}<14$. Width 2 groups $9\text{–}<11$, $11\text{–}<13$, $13\text{–}<15$, $15\text{–}<17$ have frequencies 3, 7, 12, 3 and cumulative frequencies 3, 10, 22, 25. Both modal and median class become $13\text{–}<15$. Exact values within either grouping are unknown. Wider classes smooth detail; apparent features depend partly on the chosen class boundaries.
:::
